parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: There’s a 20% ____ on shampoo today, so this one costs £4 instead of £5!
Bus drivers in London have gone on ____ . They’re demanding better pay.
I wouldn’t drive in the ____ hour if I were you; it’s quicker to walk!
Once all the passengers were on ____ , the plane prepared for take-off.
You should have a T-shirt on. How can you wear anything with long ____ in hot weather like this?!
Mary: “I hate my brother!” Father: “Come ____ , Mary. You know that’s not true.”
Are you feeling ____ to going out this evening? If not, we can stay at home.
Write the address carefully and don’t ____ out the postcode.
We ____ what had gone wrong for a very long time.
I love my ____ . She’s a wonderful human being.
____ regards travel and accommodation, the company will pay for everything.
Don’t get a taxi to the airport, John. I’m driving there, so just stay where you are and I’ll come and ____ you on the way.
Bob Stanton had always wanted to settle in Australia and, in 1948, he ____ realize his ambition. It was a dream come true.
My work as a police officer involves ____ into dangerous situations that people would normally advise you to avoid.
I wish I had ____ up boxing years ago. It’s a great way to stay fit.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: If Yasmin ran this business by own, without her husband, I’ve no doubt it’d become more profitable.
The grass is looking a bit yellow due from the fact that the last rain we had here was over two months ago.
We missed the start of the show. The band have already been playing for about twenty minutes when we arrived.
There’s no point for driving to the beach if it’s going to be cold and cloudy.
Are you planning to join part in the summer concert this term, Ms Hodgson?
I didn’t tell Billy away when he dropped the plates; he was only trying to help me with the washing up.
If you hadn’t insisted for leaving early, I’m certain we would have missed that flight!
There’s a definite opinion among young people towards finding employment after leaving school instead of going to university.
Chickens can fly but, so good as I know, not far.
Little then little, our new house is feeling more like a family home.

parts.text: A housemate or flatmate is someone who we live with. Science can provide us with artificial arms, legs, teeth and hair. The articles in English are “the”, “a” and “an”. The word “afterwards” expresses the idea of “after that”. The three forms of “bind” are “bind, bound, bound”. The verb “swear” means to say very bad words. By public services, we mean education, healthcare, public transport and rubbish collection. Malaga is a coastal city in southern Spain with some great beaches. Trains normally run on two rails. We’ve got half an hour to wait till the coach comes. Don’t try to deny it, Amy. I saw you! Dad had a tear in his eye when everyone sang “Happy Birthday”.

teacher.2: What do we mean by unsettled weather?
teacher.4: What does a referee blow to stop the game?
teacher.6: What do we call the word “the”?
teacher.7: How many limbs do humans have?
teacher.8: What do we use to split wood?
teacher.9: What do we call a tool we use to hit nails into wood?
teacher.10: What metal is a tin made of?

1: If Yasmin ran this business by herself, without her husband, I’ve no doubt it’d become more profitable.
2: The grass is looking a bit yellow due to the fact that the last rain we had here was over two months ago.
3: We missed the start of the show. The band had already been playing for about twenty minutes when we arrived.
4: There’s no point in driving to the beach if it’s going to be cold and cloudy.
5: Are you planning to take part in the summer concert this term, Ms Hodgson?
6: I didn’t tell Billy off when he dropped the plates; he was only trying to help me with the washing up.
7: If you hadn’t insisted on leaving early, I’m certain we would have missed that flight!
8: There’s a definite trend among young people towards finding employment after leaving school instead of going to university.
9: Chickens can fly but, so far as I know, not far.
10: Little by little, our new house is feeling more like a family home.
